title: Offset Says He and Quavo Are Rebuilding Their Relationship 4 Years After Takeoff’s Death
summary: Offset shared where he stands with Migos bandmate Quavo, four years after their public feud following Takeoff's death.
body_markdown:
[Offset](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/offset) and[Quavo](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/quavo) are working it out.


The[Migos](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/migos) rapper appeared alongside DJ Whoo Kid on Shade 45 and shared why he attended his Migos bandmate’s album release party in September, following their public fallout after the death of Takeoff in 2022.


[Shade 45 Ch 45 • Eminem’s hip-hop channel Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogOffsetDJWhooKidShade45)


“Blessings, the rebuild is always the best build,” Offset told DJ Whoo Kid. “I was there to support my brother.”


“Sh*t hard,” he added. “It’s always been love.”


While Offset and Quavo previously took the stage together at the 2023 BET Awards to honor their fallen bandmate, the “Clout” rapper maintained he and Quavo are still working to mend their friendship behind the scenes.


“It’s a time and a place for everything and so we just clicking,” he shared. “We been talking for a long time. Ya’ll just ain’t know. It just wasn’t for the world to know. We had to heal behind the scenes.”


Four years later, Offset said there is still work to be done.


“We still ain’t heal,” he said. “It’s just building with your family. Some stuff don’t go out the house.”
